title: Add discount amount to order totals

request.text: Show the discount applied to an order on the order summary page.

contract.summary: GET /orders/{id} returns a new integer field discountCents in totals.
rules: discountCents is 0 when no discount applies.

task.details: Compute the discount from applied promotions and add discountCents to OrderTotals in GET /orders/{id}.

task.summary: Show the order discount on the summary page
task.details: Read totals.discountCents from GET /orders/{id} and show it above the total when it is greater than 0.

dependencies.reason: The storefront reads the new field.

mergeOrderNote: Merge and deploy orders-api before merging storefront.
